Next year marks the 20th anniversary of the iPhone, and rumors suggest the iPhone Pro models will feature a completely refreshed design. The latest leak reveals data on what are said to be larger display sizes for the upcoming models.

iPhone Pro to feature larger 6.4-inch and 7-inch displays next year

2017 marked the 10th anniversary of the iPhone, when Apple prepared a very special model: the iPhone X.

There are rumors that Apple is preparing an equally unique product for next year's 20th anniversary.

According to reports, next year's iPhone Pro models will feature a bezel-less, quad-curved display that extends to the edges of the device.

The Dynamic Island cutout may also be shrunk or removed entirely, achieving a seamless all-glass appearance.

According to the latest post from tipster Digital Chat Station, Apple is also preparing new display sizes. He states the company is testing the following specifications:

  • iPhone Pro: 6.4 inches (up from the current 6.3 inches)
  • iPhone Pro Max: 7 inches (up from the current 6.9 inches)

He added that both devices will have larger body sizes, but will maintain the aspect ratio of the current models. Therefore, it sounds like the larger screens are not simply a result of narrower bezels.

The last time Apple increased the display size of the Pro models was in 2024, when the iPhone 16 Pro grew from 6.1 inches to 6.3 inches, and the Pro Max went from 6.7 inches to 6.9 inches.

Although the size increase next year appears modest, combined with the quad-curved design, the overall feel should be significantly more refreshed.

What are your thoughts on the rumored design of next year's iPhone Pro models? Feel free to leave a comment to share.
